acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce or refute under host load (load average >100, or N CPU burners) failures of internal/tasks/dispatch TestPSRDispatchAsyncSupervision (tick within 1s, pool_sweep_test.go:414), TestCALV0053_CancelledTickKeepsState (QUIESCENCE_UNPROVED: reader leader exit not observed within the retirement bound) and TestCALV0191_StopAfterReapIsRecoveredAfterRestart (worker survived the restart), each with base vs fixed counts under the same load.
If reproduced: each test either waits on an observed event or uses a load-tolerant bound that does not widen the product bound, and one mutation of the guarded behaviour still fails it.
body: suspected: Observed 2026-10-15 by the #908/#911 dispatch lane (V1-0710/V1-1386; merged trees on origin/main 6d1f77281 and 90829d239) on darwin at load average 120-135. The whole package failed on 3 of 4 runs; each named test passed 5/5 alone and the package passed at load ~20. TestPSRDispatchAsyncSupervision belongs to the pool-sweep work (01bfc32e1). CancelledTickKeepsState exercises the CAL-V0-053 reader quarantine that V1-0710 touched, but the error was the reader-leader exit timeout, not the new recovery or proof checks. One failing run's cause was not captured. Related to V1-1391 (LCP-V0-008 deadline tests under load), which covers different packages.
title: suspected: internal/tasks/dispatch timing tests fail under host load
